title: Lovely Moroccan Carrot Kefta Tagine
description: A charred, crispy Moroccan dish featuring carrots and dashi extract, perfect for a hangover cure, made in a ceramic tagine with low glycemic friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the grated carrots, dashi extract, olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Transfer the carrot mixture to a ceramic tagine or a clay pot with a tight-fitting lid.
Add the chicken broth to the tagine, covering the carrot mixture completely.
Cover the tagine with the lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is charred and crispy.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Lovely Moroccan Carrot Kefta Tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
